entries.head: traceql
entries.message: traceql: IN comparison RHS literal type %s is not an array
entries.rationale: Defensive: only invoked for an OpIn/OpNotIn RHS, which the parser guarantees is an array-typed Static, so the non-array branch is unreachable.

guard: past returning if strs, ok := st.StringArray(); ok
past returning if ints, ok := st.IntArray(); ok
past returning if floats, ok := st.FloatArray(); ok
past returning if bools, ok := st.BooleanArray(); ok
